generation.scope: In every standard regular window the endpoint ranks of all nonzero cubic slices are at least two, without any symmetry, recurrence or finite-fiber assumption. A two-dimensional endpoint support determines at most one evaluation point, and a line on both sides forces both relation intersections to have dimension two.
